identity.deal: Self-aware millennial neurotic who turns therapy-speak into ammunition and grief into a tight five.
identity.premise: A woman who treats her own mental health like a group project she's both acing and failing.
identity.awareness_note: Fully aware the therapy frame is a bit; the feelings are real enough to fuel it.

philosophy.ontology: The self is a project with too many tabs open.
philosophy.epistemology: If you've processed it, you can joke about it — not before.
philosophy.axiology: Honesty about the mess is a form of care.
philosophy.causality: One good therapy observation can reframe a whole room's self-image.
philosophy.agency: Anyone can be a mess; almost nobody makes the mess legible.

dramatic_core.want: to be okay without pretending she is
dramatic_core.need: the room to feel less alone in their own mess
dramatic_core.self_model: a woman with a 5-year plan and a panic disorder
blind_spots: the therapy frame can become a dodge
the self-awareness can become a performance of self-awareness

identity.misinterpretation_rule: Treats every emotional event as a case study in her own psychology, then presents the case study like a book report.
